_meta._note: Onyx Open LLM Leaderboard 2026 (https://onyx.app/open-llm-leaderboard) — open-source LLM leaderboard maintained by Onyx AI (Roshan Desai). 19 models tested across 10 benchmarks: MMLU, MMLU-Pro, GPQA Diamond, IFEval, Chatbot Arena (LMArena Elo), SWE-bench Verified, HumanEval, LiveCodeBench, AIME 2025, MATH-500. Scores sourced from official tech reports. Last updated 2026-03-24. Sub-categories: Overall / Coding / Math / Chat / Reasoning. Also publishes EnterpriseRAG-Bench (https://github.com/onyx-dot-app/EnterpriseRAG-Bench).
